column1: # mapping_set_title: SWAT4HCLS BioHackathon 2025: Med2RDF to GA4GH VRS

# mapping_set_description: Mappings declared during the SWAT4HCLS 2025 BioHackathon between the Med2RDF ontology (and the FALDO, SIO and HCO terms it reuses) and the GA4GH Variation Representation Specification. Transcribed from the project's curation spreadsheet; see mappings/README.md for the normalisations applied.

# comment: The source sheet wrote some object CURIEs as g44gh:; these are corrected to vrs1: and flagged per row. One subject cell listed three CURIEs at once and is split into three rows here. The curators worked against GA4GH VRS 1.2/1.3, so objects use the vrs1: prefix (VRS 1.3). Several targets here -- Genotype, Haplotype, SequenceInterval, ChromosomeLocation, Text, Residue, Feature, Gene, UtilityVariation -- were removed in VRS 2.0, which is the version vcf-core itself targets. See mappings/vcf-core-alignments.sssom.tsv for the vcf-core to VRS 2.0 spoke. Transcription verified against the source sheet on 2026-09-08: subject, predicate and object of every row match after the normalisations noted above.
